QF.id: VB Fund Distribution and Channel Management_27

question.text: When an investor voluntarily changes their mutual fund distributor code from one distributor to another, the commission payable is __________.

answer.text: No commission is payable to either the old or new distributor
The old distributor continues to receive trail commission
The new distributor immediately starts receiving trail commission
The trail commission is split equally between the old and new distributor

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the workbook, when an investor changes the distributor code or goes direct, no commission is payable to either the old or new distributor. The Trap: It may be assumed that the new distributor would earn trail since they now service the investor, or that the old distributor retains trail on existing AUM. The rule deliberately denies commission to both. Note: The rationale in the source is to discourage distributors from luring clients into changing their distributor code purely for commission.
